shared_or_similar_visual_information: A gray-filled portion of a plane diagram. On the left, use the chain of six gray unit cells in the rectangular grid. On the right, use the larger blue region above the x-axis from the positive crossing to the right edge at x = 6.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The six marked unit squares make up the figure available for cutting and rearrangement. Right image: It selects the portion of the area measured between the upper curve and the x-axis over the indicated interval.
Rationales: The left fill identifies a discrete collection of movable or occupied cells. The right fill identifies a continuous region up to a plotted boundary, requiring a graph-based area calculation.
